seo.title: Arthritis: Symptoms, Causes, Treatment | Doctors Hub
seo.description: Learn about Arthritis — symptoms, causes, risk factors, diagnosis, treatment options, and prevention tips.

overview: Arthritis refers to joint inflammation causing pain, stiffness, and reduced mobility. Osteoarthritis (wear-and-tear) and rheumatoid arthritis (autoimmune) are the most common forms seen in Indian clinics. Treatment focuses on pain control, preserving function, and slowing disease progression.
symptoms: Joint pain and stiffness, worse in the morning (inflammatory types)
Swelling and warmth over affected joints
causes: Osteoarthritis: cartilage breakdown with age and joint stress
Rheumatoid arthritis: autoimmune attack on synovial joints
diagnosis: X-rays showing joint space narrowing or erosions
Rheumatoid factor and anti-CCP for RA
Uric acid level in suspected gout
prevention: Maintain healthy weight to reduce knee load
Regular exercise to strengthen supporting muscles
Early treatment of rheumatoid arthritis to prevent joint damage
complications: Cardiovascular disease association with inflammatory arthritis

faqs.question: What causes Arthritis?
faqs.answer: Multiple factors including genetics, lifestyle, and environment contribute.

faqs.question: Is Arthritis curable?
faqs.answer: Many conditions are manageable with proper treatment. Consult your doctor for prognosis.

emergencySigns: Hot, very swollen single joint with fever (septic arthritis)
Sudden inability to bear weight after injury
